title: L1 · NEWSROOM · Flat headline, AI capex beat 3x · card 2026-09-25-1430/k1
x:
The US factory orders report for August landed on Friday. Headline: nothing happened. Total durable goods orders $338.6bn in August. Shipments down 0.2%.

Most people stopped reading there. I didn't.

One line down: orders for business equipment excluding aircraft and defence. The closest official measure of AI data-centre spending.

Up 1.6% in August to $87.629bn. Economists expected 0.5%. Three times the number.

And July was revised to +0.6%.

So the demand side of the AI story is now showing up in Census Bureau data, not just in company guidance. That is a different quality of evidence.

This is why I read the table, not the headline. The headline was flat. The signal was one row below it.

Don't guess. Measure. Full edition, every source, on the BuyTrigger Newsroom.
